cause: V3 added an incorrect 1.6 m initial left offset to this road model and eased it back during the annotated maneuver. The base guide was also too close to the divider toward the turn. This created a false lane selection and line riding on all laps.
lane_assignment: Rightmost lane throughout the intersection exit and approach. No additional cross-lane offset is inferred from the original event labels. Original labels and times remain unchanged; the user explicitly confirmed this lane occupancy.
notes: Curb and divider observations were read from the focused native-imagery strip atlas, not generated by buffering the path. Mid-lane targets use their midpoint, then local world-coordinate smoothing. The intersection has no continuous divider; it uses the local through alignment. After station 235, rounded-curb/stop-line geometry joins the existing v3 turn entry. The first and last anchors of each listed span remain exactly at their v3 derived positions, preserving adjacent geometry. Lane bounds are approximate and do not certify a full vehicle footprint.
